about: Every reply below is exactly as the public Solana RPC answered it. The asset is a Candy Digital card whose last sale is a version-1 transaction. getTransaction replies were requested with jsonParsed and maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1; refusedWithVersion0 is the reply to the same request for the version-1 sale with maxSupportedTransactionVersion 0.

error.message: Transaction version (1) is not supported by the requesting client. Please try the request again with the following configuration parameter: "maxSupportedTransactionVersion": 1
